reviews.author: Abhishek Chandel
reviews.text:
Good AC, works just as intended.It chilles 800 Sqrft of my house, from living room kitchen and 1 bedroom.Initially I thought the front has led light strip but only plastic trim is there.Cooling is good even when the outer unit is in small duct space.The water dripping issue is something I am facing which looks like installation issue.My request to installation is that they should reach out to me and get it corrected.I had to pay 3300₹ for installation.
